proposed_widenings.name: dissolve_adhesive
proposed_widenings.justification: Universal Solvent dissolves adhesive bonds — both mundane adhesives and magical ones created by Sovereign Glue's bond_objects atom — per ounce applied to the surface. No existing effect atom covers ending a bond_objects effect or dissolving general adhesive contact. The bond_objects atom comment in types.ts explicitly defers these counter-item semantics: 'those counter-items carry the dispelling semantics in their own content, not this atom.' A new atom is therefore required in the surface.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Each ounce instantly dissolves up to 1 square foot of adhesive it touches, including Sovereign Glue.

notes: The item frame fits cleanly: magic_item activation family, legendary, no attunement, charge_pool with initialCount { kind: 'fixed', expr: { dice: 1, dieSize: 6, flat: 1 } }, activationCost { kind: 'standard_action', action: 'utilize' }, object attachment (adhesive surface within reach → Touch range), resetCadence: never. The sole encoding gap is the effect atom. dissolve_adhesive would carry a per-ounce coverage area (1 sq ft/ounce) and target: adhesive bonds including bond_objects effects. The variable spend (1+ ounces) maps naturally to the charge_pool idiom.
